purpose_zh: 登记本方案一旦取得授权进入真实运行后将触发的法律接口。本方案当前未获授权、未现场运行、不处理任何真实个人数据，因此全部接口状态为 not_yet_triggered，全部合规状态为 unknown；本文件不做任何合规结论，只回答「届时要过哪些门、由谁去过」。
purpose_en: Registers the legal interfaces this proposal will trigger once authorised and field-run. The proposal is currently unauthorised, not field-run, and processes no real personal data, so every interface is not_yet_triggered and every compliance status unknown; this file draws no compliance conclusion and only answers which doors must be passed and by whom, when the time comes.

interfaces.law_zh: 《中华人民共和国个人信息保护法》（2021）
interfaces.touchpoints_zh: 成对任务测试的参与者数据（位置、交互、退出原因、合理便利记录）；分组自报数据；申诉记录
interfaces.touchpoints_en: participant data in paired testing (location, interaction, withdrawal causes, accommodation records); self-reported group data; appeal records
interfaces.trigger_zh: 取得授权并招募真实参与者之时
interfaces.trigger_en: upon authorisation and recruitment of real participants

interfaces.law_zh: 《中华人民共和国数据安全法》（2021）
interfaces.touchpoints_zh: 运行期传感与运维数据的分级、留存与出境边界；快照与测试数据的分级留存
interfaces.touchpoints_en: classification, retention and cross-border boundaries of operating sensor and maintenance data; graded retention of snapshots and test data
interfaces.trigger_zh: 任何传感或运维数据开始产生之时
interfaces.trigger_en: when any sensing or operating data begins to exist

interfaces.law_zh: 《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》（2022）、《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》（2023）等算法治理谱系
interfaces.law_en: the algorithm-governance line: Provisions on Algorithmic Recommendation (2022), Interim Measures for Generative AI Services (2023), among others
interfaces.touchpoints_zh: 路径建议、动态导视内容生成、拥挤度提示等面向公众的算法服务是否落入备案义务
interfaces.touchpoints_en: whether route suggestions, dynamic wayfinding content and crowding hints fall under filing obligations as public-facing algorithmic services
interfaces.trigger_zh: 任一 AI 构件面向公众提供服务之时（L3 前须完成判定）
interfaces.trigger_en: when any AI component serves the public (determination required before L3)
interfaces.owner_en: operating body and counsel (to be confirmed)

note_zh: 接口清单不穷尽；取得授权后由具备资质的法务逐项复核并可扩充。法规名称与年份为公开事实登记，不构成法律意见。
note_en: The list is non-exhaustive; qualified counsel reviews and may extend it upon authorisation. Law names and years are registered as public facts, not legal advice.
